title: Parking License Commitment Months and the Length of the Lease Term Agreement
content:
Schedule note to the Parking License Addendum: the commitment months a parking license must be held before it can be cancelled without an early cancellation fee are shortened when the household has signed a longer Lease Term Agreement.

## Note

When the current Lease Term Agreement of the lease runs 13 months or more, the commitment months are the product's minimum commitment months less 2, never below zero; when it runs at least 10 but fewer than 13 months, the commitment months are the product's minimum commitment months less 1, never below zero; in every other case the commitment months are the product's minimum commitment months.

The term that decides is the lease's Lease Term Agreement in current status, by its length in months. A lease with no current term agreement falls in the last case.

## By length of the current Lease Term Agreement

| Current Lease Term Agreement runs | Commitment months |
|---|---|
| 13 months or more | the product's minimum commitment months less 2, never below zero |
| 10, 11 or 12 months | the product's minimum commitment months less 1, never below zero |
| fewer than 10 months, or no current term agreement | the product's minimum commitment months |

## Illustrations (hypothetical products)

| Product's minimum commitment | 14-month term | 12-month term | 10-month term | 9-month term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 months | 4 | 5 | 5 | 6 |
| 3 months | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| 1 month | 0 (never below zero) | 0 | 0 | 1 |
